Is dynamic array stored in same way for memory memory: https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/v0.8.11/internals/layout_in_memory.html i came across article which says differently for dynamic array for memory https://ethdebug.github.io/solidity-data-representation/#user-content-locations-in-detail-memory-in-detail here i didnt understnad how this is possible If its seq then cant two conseq dynamic array override each other. I am in this hunch To find why mappings cant be memory ? I wanted to pass it as functional param in my project, but couldnt do so finding reason 🙂 cool will check this out Reading this I had created my own theory 😁 on why memory mappings maybe are not supported I dont know but, if anyway my understading is true 😐 I think mappings not being memory is related to the memory expansion being costly ? if i understand correctly mappings are stored in h(key. initial slot), hence value slot can go anywhere in 0 to 2 ** 256 so if use memory, for any key, we may have to expand the memory to any point, where in between slots are not utilized which would infact maybe is more gas costly due to quadratic increase of cost for memory I came to this conclusion as for even dynamic array as mentioned in above article, in memory they are stored seq and not like storage where we store length in slot and then take h(slot) and start (pic is not about the price of ETH)

excerpts.content:
Reading this I had created my own theory 😁  on why memory mappings maybe are not supported 
I dont know but,  if anyway my understading is true  😐 

I think mappings not being memory is related to the memory expansion being costly ?
if i understand correctly 
mappings are stored in h(key. initial slot), hence value slot can go anywhere in 0 to 2 ** 256 
so if use memory, for any key, we may have to expand the memory to any point, where in between slots are not utilized
which would infact maybe is more gas costly due to quadratic increase of cost for memory 
I came to this conclusion as for even dynamic array as mentioned in above article, in memory they are stored seq and not like storage where we store length in slot and then take h(slot) and start
